question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**feasible**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the fourth blank 'feasible' should be used.
 
• **Feasible** means possible or able to be done. In the given passage, the sentence talks about gaining a better understanding of something by putting in effort over a longer period of time. The word "feasible" fits in the blank as it means that this enhanced comprehension is possible or achievable through consistency. The other options do not fit in the context of the sentence.
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other options:
 
 
• **Destructible** (विनाशी): capable of being destroyed or damaged.
 
• **Feasible** (संभव): possible to do easily or conveniently.
 
• **Credible** (विश्वसनीय): able to be believed or convincing.
 
• **Fluctuating** (अस्थिर): rising and falling irregularly or unpredictably.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *Being constant (1) __entails__ repeating a task or action, or performing an activity without a stop or interval. Consistency can never be attained in a sporadic or (2) __intermittent__ manner. When you perform anything regularly or constantly, you will not only build expertise in that area, but you will also gain a better (3) __comprehension__* *of it. Because of the greater amount of effort put in over a longer period of time, this enhanced comprehension is **(4) **__**feasible**__**. As a result, consistency is the (5) _______ that allows anyone to consistently put in the effort.*
